# Native runtime services for local development.
# Start shared infrastructure first with:
#   docker compose --env-file .env up --wait
version: "0.5"

environment:
  - ENV=dev
  - AUTH_MODE=disabled
  - PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
  - DB_USER=postgres
  - DB_PASSWORD=${DB_PASSWORD}
  - DB_HOST=localhost
  - DB_PORT=5432
  - TEMPORAL_JOB_SERVICE_URL=http://localhost:18015
  - TEMPORAL_HOST=localhost:7233
  - TEMPORAL_SERVER_URL=localhost:7233
  - TEMPORAL_ADDRESS=localhost:7233
  - TEMPORAL_NAMESPACE=default
  - TEMPORAL_S3_BUCKET_NAME=temporal-payloads
  - TEMPORAL_S3_ENDPOINT_URL=http://localhost:9000
  - TEMPORAL_S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID=${S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID}
  - TEMPORAL_S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=${S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY}
  - TEMPORAL_S3_REGION=eu-west-1
  - QUARANTINE_S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID=${S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID}
  - QUARANTINE_S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=${S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY}

  # ----- LLM model routing (single source of truth) ------------------------
  # Each module hard-codes provider-specific model names in its own .env.local
  # (self-hosted/gpt-oss-120b, Qwen/..., bge-m3, gemma-...). The local LiteLLM
  # proxy only serves the models the operator actually configured, so force
  # every module's model variable to one of the three names from the root .env
  # (written by scripts/create_secrets.sh). Module variable names differ, so
  # each is set explicitly; a process ignores variables it does not read, and
  # OS env set here overrides the value in the module's .env.local.
  #   LITELLM_TEXT_MODEL     -> chat / completion
  #   LITELLM_EMBEDDING_MODEL -> text embeddings
  #   LITELLM_VISUAL_MODEL   -> vision / multimodal (image + PDF-page input)
  # Chat:
  - LLM_MODEL=${LITELLM_TEXT_MODEL}
  - LITELLM_MODEL=${LITELLM_TEXT_MODEL}
  - LITELLM_MODEL_NAME=${LITELLM_TEXT_MODEL}
  - MODELS_LARGE_LLM=${LITELLM_TEXT_MODEL}
  - MODELS_MEDIUM_LLM=${LITELLM_TEXT_MODEL}
  - MODELS_SMALL_LLM=${LITELLM_TEXT_MODEL}
  - LLM_DB_RESEARCH_MODEL=${LITELLM_TEXT_MODEL}
  - LLM_PAGEINDEX_SVM_MODEL_STAGE1=${LITELLM_TEXT_MODEL}
  - LLM_PAGEINDEX_SVM_MODEL_STAGE2=${LITELLM_TEXT_MODEL}
  - METADATA_MODEL_NAME=${LITELLM_TEXT_MODEL}
  - STRUCTURE_MODEL_NAME=${LITELLM_TEXT_MODEL}
  - SCHWERPUNKTTHEMA_MODEL_NAME=${LITELLM_TEXT_MODEL}
  - SUMMARIZATION_MODEL_NAME=${LITELLM_TEXT_MODEL}
  # VLM_SUMMARY_MODEL_NAME summarises the *text* output of a prior VLM run -> chat.
  - VLM_SUMMARY_MODEL_NAME=${LITELLM_TEXT_MODEL}
  - LLM_CATEGORISATION_MODEL=${LITELLM_TEXT_MODEL}
  - LLM_SUMMARISATION_MODEL=${LITELLM_TEXT_MODEL}
  - LLM_ENRICHMENT_MODEL=${LITELLM_TEXT_MODEL}
  # Embeddings (plausibilitaet reads LITELLM_EMBEDDING_MODEL directly from .env):
  - EMBEDDING_MODEL=${LITELLM_EMBEDDING_MODEL}
  - LLM_EMBEDDING_MODEL=${LITELLM_EMBEDDING_MODEL}
  - CHUNKING_MODEL=${LITELLM_EMBEDDING_MODEL}
  # Vision / multimodal (modul-inhaltsextraktion: VLM enhancement + LightOnOCR):
  - VLLM_MODEL=${LITELLM_VISUAL_MODEL}
  - LIGHT_ON_OCR_MODEL=${LITELLM_VISUAL_MODEL}

processes:
  project-logic:
    command: uv run --locked --all-packages uvicorn src.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 18000 --reload
    working_dir: ./02-backend/project_logic_service
    environment:
      - DB_NAME=project_logic
      - TEMPORAL__HOST=localhost:7233
      - TEMPORAL__TASK_QUEUE=project-logic-service
      - TEMPORAL__NAMESPACE=default
      - TEMPORAL__S3_BUCKET_NAME=temporal-payloads
      - TEMPORAL__S3_ENDPOINT_URL=http://localhost:9000
      - TEMPORAL__S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID=${S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID}
      - TEMPORAL__S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=${S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY}
      - TEMPORAL__S3_REGION=eu-west-1
      - API__ADMINISTRATIVE_FILE_DRAFT_BASE_URL=http://localhost:18010
    readiness_probe:
      http_get:
        host: localhost
        port: 18000
        path: /docs
      initial_delay_seconds: 20
      period_seconds: 5
    availability:
      restart: on_failure
      backoff_seconds: 3

  project-logic-seed:
    command: uv run --locked --all-packages python -m src.scripts.seed_data
    working_dir: ./02-backend/project_logic_service
    environment:
      - TEMPORAL__S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID=${S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID}
      - TEMPORAL__S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=${S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY}
    depends_on:
      project-logic:
        condition: process_healthy

  document-management:
    command: uv run --locked --all-packages uvicorn src.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 18001 --reload
    working_dir: ./02-backend/document_management_service
    environment:
      - DB_NAME=dms
      # Origin embedded in presigned upload/download URLs handed to the browser. Overrides the
      # service's .env.local. Same-origin as the frontend behind a reverse proxy; localhost otherwise.
      - S3_EXTERNAL_URL=${S3_PUBLIC_URL}
      - TEMPORAL__HOST=localhost:7233
      - TEMPORAL__TASK_QUEUE=dms
      - TEMPORAL__PLS_TASK_QUEUE=project-logic-service
      - TEMPORAL__NAMESPACE=default
      - TEMPORAL__S3_BUCKET_NAME=temporal-payloads
      - TEMPORAL__S3_ENDPOINT_URL=http://localhost:9000
      - TEMPORAL__S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID=${S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID}
      - TEMPORAL__S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=${S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY}
      - TEMPORAL__S3_REGION=eu-west-1
      - TEMPORAL__ENABLE_APPROVAL=false
    readiness_probe:
      http_get:
